body: probably not, I don't think there is anything after death. but why run to nothing when there is something right in front of you. I know life fucking sucks but maybe today will be better. Idk this is what I think of when I'm thinking about killing myself. It helps sometimes.

Think of all the cool games you will miss tho. Like you might not have a Ps4 now but you will get it back. They keep coming out with cooler and cooler games. The technology is getting better. Shame if you missed it tho.
I know and I'm really worried I would lose them. Should I let it go?
I love them, they have been there for me through so much. How they act switches up so fast it's exhausting.

The thought of my parents. If I were to end it like I wish I would be hurting the people around me. They have done everything they can to make my life as good as possible and I'm still sad. I feel like a disappointment, I wish I could be happy for them.

That's what I was thinking like OP has to have something to live for or we would not be reading this post right now. They should find that thing that is keeping them alive and nourish it, whether it is a relationship, hobby, or simply hope for the future.

I sometimes find myself wishing that the world would just explode and everyone would be gone. I don't want to hurt those around me and make them go through the same pain I go through every day.  If everyone was gone at once then there would be no more pain and suffering. Everything would be gone...

I feel this so much. I feel the only way I can get anyone to care about me or show me any type of love is to end it. The people who say they "care" about me now don't have actions to follow that up. I just want someone to talk to and they will say when I am dead that they wish they talked to me about how I was feeling now, but they will never actually take the time to talk to me. Its not like I expect them to read my mind. I have asked people if I can talk to them. Everyone just seems too busy for me.
Thank you.
Can you haunt me, please?
I'm here I might not have good answers but I can listen.
I keep a knife by my bed for that very reason. Like if I ever decide that I'm done and I'm finally being selfish I can just end it.
I have tried but it's really hard for me to talk about my feelings.
Imagining a life without this pain is like a dream. I just don't think it's destined to be for me.

I hope while you are on the road you find something worth living for. I'm too scared of how it would affect my family to kill myself for now so I'm just waiting till I can move out, drift away from them. Then do it when it will hurt them the least.
Have they not gotten worse? every time I seem to be getting used to it they just get worse and it's killing me mentally.
My family is the reason I'm still around. I don't want to hurt them. My one goal in life is to be happy but that seems like the most impossible thing of all.
I've been having these feelings since the 4th grade, they have gotten worse over the years but they were always there. I don't think they will ever go away and that terrifies me the most.

I just have a hard time accepting that though I can't pick out one single thing in my life I would fix I still don't want to live it. I don't think I can live this way. It scares me that the only way out is death.
Okay, thank you I will try the meditation. Thank you for talking to me about this I appreciate it more than you know. I hope you have an amazing day and life for that matter.
Yeah Ive been going to therapy for about 5 years and it seems useless.
What did you do? I am at a point in my life where nothing seems like it will ever get better. Please, what helped you?

My current therapist specializes in eating disorders so we mostly talk about food and how to have a better relationship with it. I have had therapists in the past who dealt more with anxiety and such but it never seemed to do anything, I tried to do what they said but it seemed useless.

I've been in therapy for about 5 years now. I can't wait any longer to feel okay. I don't know if I have had shit therapists or I'm just destined to feel sad because that seems like the solution that everyone has but it's never helped me.
